responsibility: Implements Graphite’s isl-based schedule optimizer. Given a polyhedral SCoP with domains and computed dependences, it builds isl schedule constraints for validity, coincidence, and proximity, configures isl scheduling options, computes the transformed schedule, and optionally applies simple loop tiling to permutable leaf bands using the loop-block tile-size parameter. It is the stage that decides whether a SCoP receives a new schedule at all, preserves the original schedule when optimization is identical or only identity/parallelization modes are requested, and emits missed-optimization diagnostics for isl failures or operation quotas.
